lines.en: Far away — where the grass is greener////
Two young girls were spending their afternoon sitting beside one another, shielded from the cruelty of the world in this fortress of an apartment complex.
The only problem is that one of them had already been exposed to the cruelty of the world just a couple nights ago when a large man decided to use her room as a love hotel while she was still inside.
She hadn’t been able to stop thinking about this ever since it happened. None of the thoughts were good, though.
As a matter of fact, none of them were really bad either. They were just thoughts. Confusion. Nothing more.
So as she lay there beside a friend, she decided to keep her mouth shut. At least for now.
But as she gazed down at a line of arithmetic she’d been using to distract herself, she thought of something to distract her from that.
She remembered the sounds. Those slapping, wet sounds. Like a slab of meat being thrown onto the table and tenderized by the hands of an inexperienced chef.
Maybe she should speak up? Maybe Chinami had seen something similar? Maybe she would better understand exactly what was happening if she was asked to weigh in?
Which isn’t to say Tsukasa didn’t understand. She was a smart girl. But there’s a distinct difference between just hearing about open heart surgery and then seeing it with your own eyes.
There are parts that someone without any training just won’t understand. It’ll look scary. Confusing. Gross. And it is. But it is because it’s supposed to be. Just like that thing she saw!
What was it called again? Sex? That was the word, right? She remembered the word. And she remembered something about penises and vaginas. How boys and girls have different parts. That she knew.
But then those memories of the sounds came back. Followed by the memories of the way Jeeves handled that loud woman’s body. Tsukasa had never even been that rough with her stuffed animals before.
: Mmm...

She lets out a sound on accident. Not to be confused with the sounds that loud woman let out on purpose. She felt good, right? She didn’t seem like she was in pain. But it didn’t look particularly fun and-
: Is something wrong, Tsukasa?
Good. Now she didn’t have to be alone with her thoughts anymore. All she had to do was not mention sex and-
: Chinami, what do you know about sex?
Mission failed immediately. Her curiosity had once more gotten the best of her.
: Wh...What?!
: Sex. It’s when a man and a woman-
: Chinami knows what it is! She’s seen it on TV! She just wants to know why you’re asking something so mature!
: You remember that we had your sister’s Christmas party at my house this year, right?
: Of course Chinami remembers! She wanted to go but had to stay home alone because the outside world hates her.
: Well, I may have...seen something.
: Mm...Big sis Chika has been going kinda crazy lately. Chinami thinks she wants Papa to love her more. So if you saw them together-
: Your sister wasn’t involved. It was Jeeves and some other woman.
: PAPA, NO!
: Have you learned about that stuff yet, Chinami? Or, better yet, have you seen your sister and Jeeves do it together?
: No! They don’t do that stuff in here! Or at least...not while Chinami is awake! She can’t confirm or deny what happens when she’s sleeping!
: I see, I see.
: Oh well. Carry on then, I suppose.
: Y...Yeah. Chinami will...carry on.
And so the two of them went back to their books. One continued to fiddle with numbers while the other was neck-deep in a fight sequence between some green guy and some orange guy.
She forgot their names. It was hard to focus at the moment.
They stayed like this for quite some time.
: What do you think it feels like?
: Tsukasa!
Until they didn’t.
: Is something the matter?
: Yes! We’re not supposed to talk about this kind of stuff! Stop trying to turn Chinami into a bad girl!
: But now is the perfect time to discuss topics we’d otherwise be banned from since there’s no one around to tell us we can’t. It’s just like when I give you insider trading tips.
: Those are for Chinami’s secret 401k! She makes an exception for them since they directly impact her future!
: Fine. I guess you’re just not mature enough to handle such an adult discussion then.
: Chinami guesses so too. And that is fine with her.
: I guess we’ll just go back to our books then.
: Chinami is way ahead of you...
: It looked kind of scary.
: If you’re trying to kill Chinami, at least do it with peanuts!
: Penis?
: Don’t pretend you didn’t actually hear what Chinami said!

: I don’t know what else to do! I don’t want to tell my mom or my sister because they’ll probably get mad at Jeeves! And I don’t want to ask Jeeves because...I feel like I...wasn’t supposed to see that.
: Did you go somewhere you weren’t supposed to?
: Oh, no. They did it in my room.
: PAPA, NO!
: She’s not going to have a baby now, is she?
: I...uhh...Chinami...doesn’t think so?
: She thinks that...there are ways to prevent it? Otherwise she’d have a million little sisters by now.
: A million? You think they do it that much?
: Chinami doesn’t want to know how many times they do it!
: Really? Why?
: Because...she doesn’t. That’s Chinami’s dad. It’s gross. Also, why were they in your room?!
: Jeeves probably just remembered how exceptional the atmosphere was and wanted to impress that woman. Some sort of mating ritual perhaps?
: Oh. Maybe that’s why they don’t do it in Chinami’s house then. Your house sounds better.
: It is better. But that’s beside the point, Chinami.
: Well, what is the point?! Because Chinami is feeling very confused and very flustered right now and still thinks we shouldn’t be talking about this!
: It’s merely a bodily function. And surely the two of us will also be doing things like that one day. Wouldn’t it make more sense to understand them now so we’re not confused when that time comes?
: Chinami is never going to do stuff like that because Chinami never leaves the house.
: Maybe Jeeves will do it with you if you ask politely?
: GET OUT OF CHINAMI’S HOUSE! PAPA WOULD NEVER! EVEN IF HE IS A LOLICON!
: What’s a lolicon?
: SOMEONE WHO WOULD STAND OUTSIDE OF THE DOOR AND LISTEN TO THIS CONVERSATION WITH A WEIRD SMILE ON THEIR FACE!
: Chinami! I’m home!
: SISTER, NO!
: Oh, Tsukasa. You’re here too.
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Shhhhh! Don’t say any of that stuff in front of Big sis Chika!
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Why not? She possesses the information that both of us lack. We can become sex experts with her guidance.

: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Chinami doesn’t want to be a sex expert! She wants to read her manga and find out if the green guy beats the orange guy before Big Sis Yumi takes it back!
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Do you think Big Sis Yumi is having sex with Jeeves too?
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ No! But between us, I definitely think she wants to.
: Why do I feel like there’s a whole lot of telepathic communication going on right now?
: Chika, can I ask you a question about something?
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Please don’t! Chinami feels like you’re about to make her life a whole lot more difficult! And it’s already too hard for her!
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Don’t worry. I won’t tell her it was Jeeves. I don’t want that woman to be murdered.
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ That only kind of helps!
: I still feel like there’s some telepathy going on here, but sure. What’s up?
: What does “sex” feel like?
: What does...what?! Where did you hear that word?!
: Hah...
: I was watching one of the presentations my family provides about the reproductive system this morning, but it lacked real world context that I believe would enhance the experience.
: Then...ask your mom?
: My mom hates me now. You’re my only hope.
: What? Tsukasa, your mom does not hate you. She loves you very much. Parenting is just...complicated sometimes. But I’m sure she’d gladly help you if you asked her about this.
: Can’t you just tell me? I know now that’s what you and Jeeves were doing when you played that really loud game at the onsen.
: Jeeves?
: She’s...talking about Papa...

: I know who she’s talking about. I’ve only gone on one onsen trip. There’s no way I could ever afford to actually pay to stay in a place like that. And I don’t win radio contests often. Probably since it’s 2020.
: Just tell me — on a scale of one to a thousand, how good does it feel?
: Two thousand.
: That’s so high! No wonder you and that other woman were so loud!
: What other woman?!
: From...the presentation I watched, obviously!
: Tsukasa, since I’m only your honorary sister at this point and not an actual one, I’m going to keep this lesson extremely brief.
: Sex feels good because it’s all about establishing a connection with someone you really care about. When that happens, it’s one of the most amazing feelings in the world.
: And sure there are...other contexts where it isn’t technically about that. But you are way too young to be getting involved with that stuff, so don’t even worry about that part for now.
: I’m not involved! I only watched! I’m just curious. That’s all.
: Watched...the presentation right? That your family put on?
: Hm? Oh. Yes. Presentation.
: So you promise you’re not going to command one of your henchmen to teach you?
: Ew! Those guys?! I barely consider them human! If I was going to do it with anyone it’d be-
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ DON’T YOU DARE MENTION ANY OF MY PAPA’S NAMES!
: American movie star, Seth Rogen!
: Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ ?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!
: You too?...Seriously?...
: You and your sister both. I just...what?
: I...like his laugh?
: Tsukasa...don’t. Just don’t. Ask me again in like thirty years if you’re still curious, okay? Until then, just...do wizard stuff.
: Chinami! I’m going to start the bath. Is it okay if I go first today? I have plans in a couple hours and need time to do my makeup again.
: Of course, big sis Chika! Anything for you, big sis Chika! I love you, big sis Chika!
: You, though...
: I hope you enjoy your stay on Chinami’s shit list...
: Chinami! You know we’re not allowed to say bad words.
: Sex is a bad word, darn it!
: It is?!
: Probably! And even if it’s not, it is in this house! Especially when it’s in relation to Papa!

: Fine. But one day, you’re going to become a woman like me who has witnessed firsthand a bond between lovers and/or very good friends. And when that day comes, Chinami...I will not be there to help you.
: Chinami sure hopes so because she feels like something really bad would need to happen for us to both witness such a thing at the same time.
: It’s not as bad as you make it sound, you know. It was kind of just...weird. But also interesting.
: It didn’t last very long, though.
: Chinami doesn’t know why, but she feels like you’re insulting her dad right now.
: Do you think I should tell him I saw his secret tryst? Or would that be unbecoming of a lady like me?
: Why would you tell him?
: To use it against him as blackmail, of course. What kind of fool do you take me for?
: The fool who almost made Chinami get “the talk.” Chinami’s avoided the talk forever. You put her streak in jeopardy.
: What’s this “talk” you speak of? There are many talks in relation to reproductive health. But each one is conducted by a separate-
: No, Tsukasa. “The talk” is what we peasants call it when our parents or guardians teach us about naughty stuff. We don’t get special presentations or anything like that.
: Then how do you even know about “the talk” before receiving the talk?
: Everybody learns about “the talk” before getting “the talk.” That’s part of “the talk.”
: This sounds like a rather convoluted talk to me.
: It is. So ask your mom if you really want to know. You heard my sister. She doesn’t hate you.
: Maybe “hate” is too strong of a word, but...
: She certainly doesn’t want me. She basically told me outright.
: Tsukasa...
: But that’s okay! Tsukasa Tsukioka is stronger and smarter and more mature than anyone gives her credit for! She’ll prove to everybody just how valuable she is! Mark my...her words!
: That just makes Chinami feel bad, so she’s decided to take you off her shit list until you can get back on your feet.
: Nonsense, Chinami!
: I’ve never been more confident in my future than I am right now!
Life for Tsukasa Tsukioka was looking up all of a sudden!
What could possibly go wrong?
Tsukasa’s affection has increased to [tsukasa_love]!
